description: Long-lived MCP daemon — keeps LSPs (intelephense/pyright/etc) warm across calls. Avoids 30s+ cold-start per invocation.

mcp_daemon.description: Start MCP daemon for SERVER_NAME. Blocking; --detach to background.

mcp_status.description: List running MCP daemons: name, pid, uptime, idle, socket.

mcp_stop.description: Stop MCP daemon SERVER_NAME. SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 3s.
